semiconductor_relevance: High — Toray Engineering Co., Ltd. specializes in inspection and measurement equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, making it a relevant player in the industry.
summary: Toray Engineering Co., Ltd. provides advanced inspection and measurement solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, including the INSPECTRA® series of wafer inspection systems. The company leverages its expertise in mechanical engineering to develop unique technologies for high-precision applications in the semiconductor and FPD sectors.

regional_presence.Japan: The company offers leading solutions in Japan for high-end semiconductor products.
